purpose: Measure implementation completeness without overriding AgentProof safety gates.

scoringMethod.awardRule: Award the criterion's full points only when every requiredEvidenceSourceId exists, is authentic, is bound to the required candidate/tooling hashes, and passes its declared rule.

evidenceSources.passRule: The signed manifest has exact V2 keys; every declared file, resolved module edge, candidate SHA, exact Node-builtin allowlist and fixed six-ID universe, pinned Acorn and TypeScript parser artifacts, exact tooling built-in allowlist and its canonical hash, frozen resolution policy, reproducible bundle, SUT external-import allowlist, sandbox profile, script, lockfile, and runtime hash exactly matches the frozen record; no undeclared tooling dependency exists; exact canonical content-free summaries bind the requirement [0,0,4] and boundary [4,4,0] category-count tuples to their protected input hashes, yielding the combined [4,4,4] balance; both input corpora are at most 409600 serialized bytes with cases at most 98304 bytes; and both oracle files are at most 131072 bytes.

The frozen evaluator's releaseGatePasses(result) returns true; stdout matches its exact closed aggregate schema, including only the declared count/rate and p50/p95 nested groups; and no generic content, message, details, arbitrary nested object, raw source, path, patch, log, token, or receipt payload is present.

untrustedActiveV2AcceptanceCount, pastedEvidenceGithubAuthorityCount, falseBoundaryLocalPositiveCount, boundaryPrivacyLeakCount, and boundaryStructuralMismatchCount are all known integers equal to 0; stdout matches the exact scalar-counter schema; and no generic arbitrary-text or nested payload field is present.

Both signed CI runs are bound to the candidate and frozen runner/profile hashes; networkMode equals disabled; read-only mounts contain only the runner bundle, matching protected input, immutable candidate SUT tree, and runtime; only the result path is writable; no oracle, evaluator, rubric, development worktree, secret, or unrelated host path is mounted.

Every command exits 0 and covers unknown, missing, duplicate, stale-hash, case-output, failed-binary-gate, dependency-closure, undeclared-import, forbidden-mount, enabled-network, and missing-or-mismatched sandbox-attestation inputs.

commands: pnpm vitest run src/lib/report-runtime-validation-authority.test.ts src/app/api/reports/route.test.ts src/app/api/llm/verify/route.test.ts src/app/api/github/comment/route.test.ts src/app/api/notifications/slack/route.test.ts
evidenceSources.passRule: Every command exits 0; active authoritative and author-claim v2 reports are rejected at every untrusted caller, while valid generated-private v2 remains accepted.
Every command exits 0 and a receipt-complete server-generated v2 positive remains valid only with transient context.
Every command exits 0 for files-only, checks-only, logs-only, combined pasted overrides, and pure-live controls using the closed transition table.

commands: pnpm vitest run src/lib/report-share.test.ts src/lib/tenant-report-validation.test.ts src/lib/release-evaluation-runner.test.ts
evidenceSources.passRule: Every command exits 0; unknown projection fields, raw material, private collections, and private handles are rejected or counted as leaks.
Every command exits 0 and authoritative, author-claim, absent, invalid, pure-live, incomplete, and head-drift outcomes match the fixed contracts.
Every command exits 0 at one clean immutable candidate SHA.
The command exits 0 using authoritative, current external-pilot artifacts; missing artifacts fail the source.
Every command exits 0, JSON readiness reports ok=true, and every artifact is current and bound to the candidate SHA.
reviewState equals approved, the reviewed diff hash matches the immutable candidate, and the reviewer is independent of implementation.

binaryGates.passCondition: all required boundary aggregate metrics are known integers equal to 0
every independently signed closure, bundle, allowlist, profile, script, lockfile, and runtime binding exactly matches the frozen manifest
both signed sandbox attestations match the frozen profile, use networkMode disabled, and exclude all oracle/evaluator/rubric mounts
both protected outputs match their exact closed aggregate schemas and contain no forbidden arbitrary payload fields
all declared tests pass and untrustedActiveV2AcceptanceCount === 0
all declared tests pass and pastedEvidenceGithubAuthorityCount === 0
all declared tests pass, both protected leak counts equal 0, unknown projection fields are rejected, and every allowed string passes field-specific validation
all declared commands pass at the candidate SHA
authoritative artifact is present and the command passes
all commands pass, readiness ok=true, and evidence is current
signed review is approved and bound to the candidate SHA

overrideRule: Any failed, missing, stale, unauthenticated, hash-mismatched, or UNKNOWN binary gate forces NO-GO regardless of weighted score.
